rv.q: Those expecting a traditional take on Charles Dickens' classic holiday perennial may be in for a shock at the new Broadway version of 'A Christmas Carol.'
In a move in line with increased efforts for better representation in the arts, two young disabled actors play Tiny Tim, Sebastian Ortiz and Jai Ram Srinivasan, both of whom have cerebral palsy.

cn.t: This Broadway adaptation earns mixed reviews, with critics praising strong ensemble performances and inclusive casting of disabled actors as Tiny Tim, but some find the production's nontraditional approach dour and less potent than the classic tale.
